debian.suites.description: Debian distribution codenames (suites) to support; builds will target all listed suites.

debian.architectures.description: CPU architectures to build packages for.

debian.keyring.description: Path to GPG keyring used to verify package signatures.

key.description: Path to GPG keyring for repository verification.

repositories.description: List of APT repositories to add to chroots for builds. Each defines source, distribution, components, and key.

paths.chroot_base.description: Base directory where chroot environments are stored.

paths.log_dir.description: Directory for build logs and daemon logs.

paths.cache_dir.description: Directory for package cache and build artifacts.

daemon.bind_host.description: IP address or hostname the mini-buildd HTTP API will bind to.

daemon.api_port.description: Port number for the HTTP API (admin, status, and job endpoints).

daemon.max_builds.description: Maximum number of concurrent builds allowed.

daemon.worker_count.description: Number of background worker processes for build queuing and cleanup.

daemon.use_https.description: Enable HTTPS for the API endpoint (requires valid cert/key files).

daemon.cert_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate (used only if use_https is true).

daemon.key_file.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key (used only if use_https is true).

notifications.email_enabled.description: Enable email notifications for build events (success/failure).

notifications.email_recipients.description: List of email addresses to notify about build results.

notifications.smtp_host.description: SMTP server hostname for sending notifications.

notifications.smtp_use_tls.description: Use STARTTLS for SMTP connection (recommended for port 587).

build.timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds allowed per build job before termination.

build.keep_success_artifacts.description: If true, preserve successful chroot snapshots for reuse; saves time on rebuilds.

build.default_packages.description: Packages to always install in build chroots (minimum toolchain for package compilation).
